messages.content: I’ll sell into the high-priced DA evening hours, recharge in the cheapest midday hours, and capture an early-day spread with the remaining cycle allowance. I’ll then advance through every watch and reassess as RT prices and notices arrive.

At 18:00, the battery is full and has 32 discharge units left. No notice has changed its limits. I’m retaining the 19:00–21:00 discharge schedule; the latest RT prices don’t provide a strong reason to shift it.
